_what: Frozen fixture of the RETIRED hand-modelled census that tools/quant_scenarios.py used to print (65.7198 GiB text bf16). tools/quant_scenarios.py was rebuilt (commit a912ac9) to derive its census from files, so that broken model no longer exists anywhere on disk; this file pins its per-family element counts so tools/bf16_census.py closure C4 stays witnessed NON-VACUOUS against it. C4's named-cause list is a decomposition of THIS census, not of the live one.
_why_a_fixture: A closure whose defect signature has no input left to check reads 0 whether or not the tool is broken. C4 used to prove itself by reproducing quant_scenarios' real -222,179,328-element error term by term; after the repair the live delta is 0 elements on every family, so the same five terms produce a -444,358,656 B residual and the gdn delta that used to witness non-vacuity reads 0. Pinning the broken census keeps both halves true: the live comparison requires 0 elts on every family (a regression check on the repaired tool), and the defect decomposition stays fired-and-caught against this file (the non-vacuity witness). This is not a tolerance and nothing here is tuned to make a check pass; it is a snapshot of a state independently reproducible from git.
_provenance: The eight family values are what census() returned from tools/quant_scenarios.py at revision a912ac9^ (the commit the rebuild replaced), re-evaluated against checkpoints/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.config.json on 2026-10-26 by W12. The total reproduces the retired print exactly: 35,283,072,128 elements = 70,566,144,256 bf16 bytes = 65.7198 GiB. The per-family differences against tools/bf16_census.py's authoritative census reproduce quantization/evidence/bf16-census-adjudication-2026-10-26.md section 3 to the element. Elements first, GiB last, per that file's own rule.

_retired_family_expressions.gdn_linear_attn: nlin * ((2*lk*dk + lv*dv)*h + (lv*dv)*h + lv*h + lv*h + (2*lk*dk + lv*dv)*kf + 2*lv + 2*h + dv)  -- no out_proj term, and '+ 2*h' is a phantom
_retired_family_expressions.norms_misc: (2*L+4)*h + 3*h*(3*h)  -- the 9h^2 term is a phantom; 2L+4 undercounts the 86 h-norms; mtp.fc absent

_delta_convention: authoritative minus broken, in ELEMENTS -- the sign convention tools/bf16_census.py and adjudication section 3 use. quant_scenarios.py's own fault injections carry the same magnitudes with the OPPOSITE sign, because they perturb the tool's own census: its _f_out_proj is -251,658,240 where the out_proj term here is +251,658,240.

defect_decomposition_elements_authoritat.term: GDN out_proj / ssm_out [h, lv*dv] x 30 linear layers, absent from the tool's gdn term
the gdn term's '+ 2*h' per linear layer x 30; the term had 8 summands for the 9 tensors a GDN layer carries, and the tensor left with no summand was out_proj
norms_misc's '3*h*(3*h)' = 9h^2; no tensor family of that size exists in this checkpoint
norm count: 86 h-sized norms exist (40 input + 40 post + language_model.norm + the draft's five), the tool modelled 2L+4 = 84
mtp.fc.weight [h, 2h], the draft block's fusion projection, absent from the tool

_figures_the_broken_census_alone_produce.note: The three figures quoted across README.md, AGENTS.md, PLAN.md and DECISIONS.md D-01/D-11 before the correction. The corrected rows from the repaired tool: 66.1337 GiB text bf16, policy A 19.7848 GiB resident, 2.5252 GiB/token with one draft pass (2.4653 target-only). Adjudication sections 3 and 6.
